Definition: from G5395; to cause a blaze, i.e. ignite (figuratively, to inflame with passion):--set on fire.
BiblicalUsage: Phlogizo means to set on fire, to inflame, and it appears once, in James's warning about the tongue. The tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity, and it defiles the whole body and sets on fire the course of nature, and it is set on fire of hell.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tongue's fire is the smallest blaze with the largest burn: one spark from hell can set a whole life alight.
